note: pixel positions inside the 4500x680 full-res images. Multiply by (web_width/4500) for the web copies (2200px wide => 0.4889).

entry_left.layers_above_tail: the WHOLE buckle frame (clip of entry-left-noprong, cols 3760-4400) + the two keeper clips (keeper_cols) + the prong. The tail runs UNDER these and OVER the rest of the strap, so the frame always looks complete.
entry_left.lock_hole: the tail hole that lands at col 4275 (the prong tip)

entry_prong.lifted_pose: scaleX ~0.5 with slight upward shift; animate to 1 for the click

entry_right.note: hole 0 is nearest the tip (17.5 cm from it); holes are 2.5 cm = 250px apart
entry_right.align_formula: tail_offset_x = 4275 - (1850 + 250*k)  (full-res px, applied to the entry-right image); k = 0..4. k=2 gives 1925.

scale: 1 cm = 100 px; strap 4 cm = 400 px; buckle frame 6.4 cm
